title: Power Rankings: Consistency, health keep Cavs at No.1
heading: 2009-10 Power Rankings: Week 11
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Not going to grade them down too much for Friday's slip at Melo-less Denver. Not when the Cavs have won six of their past seven roadies and when none of their closest pursuers is healthy enough to push 'em.
